page.notes: Top margin: the printed page number 94 and the running head "HISTORIA MOTUUM" are read as printed. The right edge shows the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out. The first word "legati" is a fragment at the page start and is transcribed as printed. Italic and roman type were judged from the scan and may be imperfect in places.
